title: Financial Instruments: Presentation
summary: Prescribes the classification of financial instruments into liabilities and equity, the split accounting of compound instruments, and offsetting criteria, converged almost exactly with IAS 32.

bannerNotice.title: Ind AS – Closely Converged with IAS 32
bannerNotice.body: Ind AS 32's liability/equity classification principles, compound instrument split-accounting, and offsetting criteria mirror IAS 32 almost exactly, with no substantive divergence. Its Indian practical relevance is prominent given the widespread use of Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares (CCPS) and redeemable preference shares in Indian startup/family business funding structures. Section 11 covers the full comparison.
